run_traced_coroutine: run a coroutine with tracing enabled and return the result along with an ExecutionResult containing the execution trace
trace_function_decorator: decorate a function with @trace to automatically record its inputs, outputs, and errors in an ExecutionResult
stream_coroutine_updates: stream updates from a coroutine execution by iterating over intermediate results via IteratorWithReturnValue
report_update_async: report an intermediate update from within a traced coroutine to the active tracer for streaming or logging
create_custom_tracer: create a custom Tracer subclass to record execution stages to a queue, file, or other destination
